استنكفت (form X)
# اِسْتَنْكَفْتُ (istankaftu) /is.tan.kaf.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَنْكَفَ (istankafa)
# اِسْتَنْكَفْتَ (istankafta) /is.tan.kaf.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَنْكَفَ (istankafa)
# اِسْتَنْكَفْتِ (istankafti) /is.tan.kaf.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَنْكَفَ (istankafa)
# اِسْتَنْكَفَتْ (istankafat) /is.t
